title: Principaux établissements d'enseignement supérieur
publisher: Ministère de l'Enseignement supérieur et de la Recherche (MESR)
lineage: CSV export downloaded by the Fetch institution registries workflow
notes: in scope: every institution in the dataset
scope: France: the ministry's list of principal higher education institutions: universities, grands établissements, public and private écoles (engineering, business, art and others) and other degree-awarding institutions.
manifest_notes: The dataset covers the main degree-awarding institutions; specialised schools outside it (art, health and vocational schools, BTS classes in lycées) are not included.
